AI vs AI · After-action report

Valkyrie's ArmyversusRamesses's Army

The Runeforge Directorate's Valkyrie, Corporaiders and Odin's Einherjar against Ramesses the Eternal Pharaoh and the dead of the Duat Dominion, at the Crossroads. The closest of six: the Directorate led after Rounds 2 and 4, and Ramesses won 31 to 21 in Round 6. Over the six battles Ramesses won all six, on average 33.0 VP to 9.8.

Ramesses's Army wins on Victory Points, 31 to 21 21 : 31 VP

Deployment

The Directorate set up on row 12 with The Gilded Ledger: the Valkyrie leading the Shieldmaidens at (5,12) (the only squad she may lead), the Hersir leading Odin's Einherjar at (3,12), Corporaider Squads at (4,12) and (10,12) and the Runesmith at (11,12). Ramesses set up on rows 1 and 2 with the Rite of the Unending: Ramesses alone at (4,1), the Canopic Priest leading the Akhguard at (11,2), Skeletal Spearmen at (7,2) and (9,2), Skeletal Archers at (3,2) and (4,2) and the Tomb Fusiliers at (5,2).

Battle Round 2

The Corporaiders charge first

VP
8:2
Units standing
8:8

65:81

Commentary

  1. Movement

    All three Corporaider Squads charge the skeletons around the centre. Skeletal Archer 1 Falls Back in disorder (2 HP); Archer 2 and the Tomb Fusiliers shoot the charging squad in Overwatch.

  2. Action

    The new Corporaiders take 4 off Archer 1; Archer 2, the Fusiliers and the Canopic Priest's Voice of the Duat put 5 into the Corporaiders. The Hersir's Mark of Acquisition and the Hostile Takeover command change nothing the record can see.

  3. Cleanup

    Corporaider Squad 1 holds the centre (3); TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (+3) and BAR THE GATES (+2) for the Directorate; LEAD FROM THE FRONT (2) for Ramesses. Valkyrie 8, Ramesses 2.

Commentary

  1. Command

    The Directorate spends 10 loot on Liquidate Assets with no target. Ramesses requisitions a Skeletal Archer squad and heals himself with Grave Return.

  2. Movement

    The Einherjar charge Skeletal Archer 1; the Akhguard charge the requisitioned Corporaiders. Ramesses walks to the west edge at (0,6), and Skeletal Archer 2 dies in a disordered Fall Back.

  4. Cleanup

    Ramesses holds the centre and the west (5), LEAD FROM THE FRONT (3) and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY (+3). Valkyrie 17, Ramesses 24.

The damage record

Every unit that dealt damage, best first. Damage counts melee, shooting, spells and abilities; a joined pair's damage is split between the two units that took it.

The scoring record

Who scored the VP. At every scoring moment the engine was asked what would have scored with some of the side's units absent: a unit's share is its extra VP averaged over every order its side's units could have arrived in (its Shapley value), so the shares add up to the VP scored. "Hinged on it" is the objective VP its side would have lost had that one unit not been there, the rest of the battle as it was. VP no unit decided (an objective held by capture, a no-losses card): Valkyrie's Army 2 VP.

The activity record

What each unit did with its 1 APt a Battle Round. A move in the Movement Phase costs Movement Points, not APt, so a unit that only walks scores as idle: that is the wasted round this record is for.

Moves undone

A move the unit's next move undoes is a turn spent getting nowhere, as in chess when a piece goes and comes back while the other side develops. A pair counts when the second move takes the unit back beside where the first began, or away again from an objective the first moved toward, no nearer than it started. A CHARGE or a Fall Back is a fight's move and does not count. In this battle 11 of 83 moves were undone.

Passive rules

Rules that act without being used: an aura, a combat effect, an army's identity. Each attack one touched is priced by the rules' own estimate with the rule on its owner and with it off; at each Movement Phase's start, the units a rule held still, slowed or kept from squares are counted, each asked of the rules with the rule taken off.

The support record

What each unit did for the rest of its army, beside its own attacks and its own share of the score, by kind: what it added to its side's attacks, what it kept off its side, what it healed, the moves it opened or denied, and the objectives its effects decided. A buffer, a healer and a spotter show here and nowhere else.

Analysis

Six of six for Ramesses

Ramesses won all six, on average 33.0 VP to 9.8, and in four of them the Directorate scored 4 VP or fewer. Ramesses held almost four times the ground (19.7 objective VP a battle to 5.2) and scored more from both the Primary (5.5 to 1.7) and the secondaries (7.8 to 3.0). The damage was even, 41.7 a battle to 40.8, but the Directorate lost 83 RP a battle to Ramesses' 29: a Skeletal Spearman squad is 8 RP for 10 HP, and the Canopic Priest raises more.

Ramesses's Army vs Valkyrie's Army: 6 battles on ACROPOLIS, CROSSROADS, TRIPLE HILLS, TWIN LAKES, seeds 1220, 1221, 1222, 1223, 1224, 1225.

Who scored

The Akhguard scored 7.6 VP a battle and Ramesses 6.1. The cheap skeletons scored for their cost: the Spearmen 25.5 VP per 100 RP and the Archers 19.6. For the Directorate nothing scored much: the Corporaiders 1.3 a squad, the Einherjar 1.4, the Hersir 1.2, the Valkyrie 0.4 and the Shieldmaidens 0.4. The Shieldmaidens, the only squad the Valkyrie may lead, were destroyed in 5 of 6 battles.

What the AI did with the Directorate

  • The Gilded Ledger's tools bought nothing. Mark of Acquisition was used 18 times and Chooser of the Slain 9, and the record found nothing either changed. Hostile Takeover was bought 13 times (12 for nothing), and Liquidate Assets twice for nothing, once with no target, spending 10 loot. Either the AI uses the Directorate's loot economy without a plan, or these abilities pay in loot the record does not price; both are worth checking before any cost change.
  • Odin's Einherjar idled 4.3 rounds a battle, and in the featured battle the Einherjar and the Shieldmaidens each walked away from the west objective and back.
  • Ramesses' tools paid. Voice of the Duat hit with all 6 casts (15 HP); Endless Procession raised 12 units, though the record calls 8 of them wasted because those units made no attack.

How sure

Six to nothing is decisive. The Duat's cheap, returning infantry wins the ground and the RP trade; the Directorate's expensive units and loot abilities, as the AI plays them, do not answer it.

What to look at next

How the AI plays the Gilded Ledger's loot (Mark of Acquisition, Hostile Takeover, Liquidate Assets), and whether the record should price loot gained.
